title: Unit – 3 : Session – 3 : SLO – 1 | Thread Life Cycle and Methods
sections: Fill: The start() method moves a thread to the RUNNABLE state.
T/F: The sleep() method pauses the thread for a specified time without releasing the lock. — TRUE
MCQ: Method that makes the current thread give up the CPU temporarily → B) yield()
Fill: A thread enters the TERMINATED (dead) state when its run() method finishes.
Find the output: t.start(); t.join(); then print — the child prints 'Hello ' first, join() makes main wait → A) Hello World
T/F: A thread can be restarted by calling start() again after it has finished. — FALSE (throws IllegalThreadStateException)
MCQ: Can cause a thread to go into the waiting state → A) join()
Fill: Calling join() on a thread causes the current thread to WAIT until the joined thread terminates.
Find the error: calling start() twice → C) IllegalThreadStateException
Fill: The method ISALIVE() is used to check if a thread is alive.
